entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ExecutionEngineException in string.Substring during high-speed sequential parsing under Server GC in .NET 10.0.203 #128011
  • [ci-scan] Interpreter osx-arm64 recurring test crashes (SIGTRAP exit 133): System.Net.Requests.Tests, System.Net.WebSockets.Clie [Content truncated due to length] #128009
  • [ci-scan] Interpreter linux-x64 intermittent test crashes (SIGABRT exit 134) in runtime-libraries-interpreter #128007
  • [ci-scan] Test crashes on osx-arm64 in runtime-libraries-interpreter: System.Net.Requests.Tests, System.Net.WebSockets.Client.Te [Content truncated due to length] #128006
  • [ci-scan] Helix dead-letter: ARM queues unavailable in runtime-coreclr gcstress0x3-gcstress0xc #128003

Closed

  • Test failure: Microsoft.Diagnostics.DataContractReader.DumpTests.AsyncContinuationDumpTests.ThreadLocalContinuation_IsContinuation #127774
  • [ci-scan] Known Build Error: Interpreter assert (iOffsetMapping == 0) == (pOffsetMapping == 0) in CompressDebugInfo #127984
  • [ci-scan] Known Build Error: JIT assert FPbased in emitarm64.cpp during SVE2/FFR code generation under jitstress #128002
  • stackalloc expression without an initializer inside SkipLocalsInit may only be used in an unsafe context #127996
